messages:
Sam: Heads up—there's a pigeon on the 3rd-floor ledge wearing a tiny sticky-note cape.
Priya: Wait what lol
Ken: I saw it earlier. Left a Post-it on the microwave that says "for the snacks".
Priya: omg is this the start of a cult
Diana: We should name it. Suggestions: Sir Beak-a-Lot, Lady Crumbs, Pigeon McPigeonface
Eli: Vote: adopt Sir Beak-a-Lot as office mascot? :+1: yes / :-1: no
Ken: +1 from me :thumbsup:
Sam: +1
Priya: abstain, but i'll bring millet tomorrow
OpsBot: OpsBot: Automated message: Please do not leave food on the shared fridge door. This keeps wildlife safe and follows snack etiquette. :robot_face:
Diana: OpsBot is on Team Pigeon smh
Sam: Also found a tiny paper crown in the stairwell. Who's the prankster? :eyes:
Maya: not me but i salute the crown-bearer :crown:
Eli: I propose a tiny laminated membership card for anyone who feeds Sir Beak-a-Lot
Ken: done. I'll make a sticker sheet. Titles? Patron, Knight, Crumb Steward
Priya: Knight for me.
Sam: Alright, motion passes, mascot adopted. Ceremony at lunch. Bring crackers. :tada:
